messages:
maria: Heads-up: infra alerted on increased 'session instability' for a handful of tenants. Same API key, sessions flip between v1 and v2 mid-conversation. console shows session_stickiness drop.

tom: do we log the pin key? iirc we use raw header blob as the residency key so tiny variant diffs will split sessions.

lee: correct. current behavior: pin_key = sha1(x-redwood-client || session_id). Clients sending different client blobs get different pins.

nina: product impact: customers see context loss, repeated re-prompts. they'd prefer "first-response wins" stickiness.

maria: proposal: canonicalize header for pinning. Rule: canonical_pin = version + session_id (if present) else version only. Keep full header in telemetry for debugging.

tom: prefer not to use SHA1(full_blob) for pin_key anymore. Use stable encoding: crc32(canonical_pin) as pin_key_hash. Less verbose in stores and faster.

lee: +1 but add salt per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant collisions in multi-tenant metrics backfill.

nina: UX ask: show "Pinned by" on conversation view: shows whether pin came from header or console override. Also indicate when canonicalization changed for tenant.

maria: rollout plan idea:
- implement canonicalization behind a runtime flag `pin.canonicalize_v2`
- run in "observe" mode for 72h (compute canonical but don't apply)
- record metric `pin_canonical_delta` boolean when canonicalized_pin != legacy_pin
- do 1% canary applying canonicalization for 24h
- scale to 25% then global if metrics OK

tom: ops note: add circuit-breaker: if canonical delta > 0.2% AND session errors spike > 0.1% then auto-disable for tenant and page oncall.

lee: telemetry details: add labels `canonical_applied`, `canonical_reason` (header|session_id|fallback), `pin_hash_v1`, `pin_hash_canonical`. store pin_hashes hashed again with tenant-salt.

nina: product prefers soft approach: when canonicalization would change a pin, return response header `X-Pin-Canonicalization: would-change` during observe, then `did-change` when applied, so SDKs can surface to devs.

maria: very useful. Can we also make console show a migration preview: list of top-10 sessions that would be remapped if we flip?

tom: feasible but can be expensive. We'll sample top session_ids by request volume and show remap rate estimate.

lee: code caveat: some legacy clients don't send session_id. for those we'll fall back to variant-less canonicalization. That could still split if they switch client variant frequently. Suggest addition: allow per-tenant override `pin_strategy: legacy|version-only|session-first`.

nina: product: expose that override, default to `version-only` when enabling canonicalization. Provide migration guidance in console.

deploy-bot: rolling deploy queued: feature/pin-canonicalize -> staging-canary (2%).

maria: monitoring/dashboard: add new tile "session-stickiness" (percent requests where pin_hash stayed constant across 5m window) and an alert when it drops below 95% for >10m.

tom: add log scrubber: we must not log raw x-redwood-client. Keep hashed keys only. Also add `pin_change_sample` logs with redacted header and reason.

lee: SDK impact: we'll add a note in changelog and provide small helper to generate canonical header in our official SDKs. Not blocking rollout.

nina: messaging: release notes blurb: "Improved session stability by canonicalizing client header pinning. Opt-in preview available in console; SDK helpers and migration docs included."

maria: timeline: dev + internal e2e by EOD; staging canary tomorrow morning; observe 72h; then 1% apply -> 25% -> global over 2 weeks if stable.

tom: I'll set up dashboards and PD runbook. lee will add runtime flag and crc32 implementation.

lee: on it. :hammer_and_wrench: will create PRs for apply/observe and the `pin_strategy` enum.

maria: action items: @lee impl; @tom dashboards/alerts and collision-salt; @nina console previews + toggle + copy. reconvene after first 24h of observe.

console-bot: note: runtime flag `pin.canonicalize_v2` created (default: off)

deploy-bot: deployed staging-canary: logs at /deploys/1773456789/pin-canonicalize

maria: thanks all — closing thread, follow-ups in PRs and the canary channel.
